gizmo.title: Kuyeserera masamu
gizmo.description: Mafunso afupiafupi a masamu opangidwa okha omwe ali ndi ndemanga zapompopompo. Sankhani machitidwe ndi mitundu ya manambala; ulendo uliwonse ndi watsopano.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Dzina la kuyeserera uku, lowonetsedwa pamutu pake.

configure.title: Machitidwe
configure.description: Mitundu ya mafunso omwe amafunsidwa. Ophunzira angazimitse iliyonse mwa izi asanayambe.

configure.title: Nambala yaing'ono kwambiri
configure.description: Nambala yaing'ono kwambiri yogwiritsidwa ntchito mu funso. Manambala athunthu, 0 kapena kupitirira.

configure.title: Nambala yaikulu kwambiri
configure.description: Nambala yaikulu kwambiri yogwiritsidwa ntchito mu funso. Mayankho a kugawa ndi ogawa nawonso amakhala mu mtundu uwu.

configure.title: Chiwerengero cha mafunso
configure.description: Kuchuluka kwa mafunso mu ulendo umodzi (1 mpaka 100).

advanced.title: Malire a nthawi
advanced.description: Masekondi ololedwa pa ulendo wonse. 0 imatanthauza palibe chowerengera nthawi, chomwe ndi chokhazikika: kuyeserera kwa nthawi kumalephera ophunzira omwe akufunika nthawi yochulukirapo. Chikakhazikitsidwa, ophunzira angathebe kuzimitsa chowerengera nthawi kwa iwo okha.

advanced.title: Mtundu wowonetsa
advanced.description: Mtundu wa chizindikiro cha pamutu ndi mabatani. Siyani chopanda kanthu kuti chitsatire mutu wa mawonekedwe.
